summary: Arqit Quantum Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching notice and proxy materials for its Annual General Meeting to be held September 8, 2026. The filing also discloses that its publicly traded warrants (ARQQW) will expire at 5:00 pm New York time on September 3, 2026, with Nasdaq expected to suspend trading after close on September 2 and delist the warrants. The proxy statement covers election of two Class II directors and other routine business. This is a routine AGM notice with a warrant expiration disclosure, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting of equity, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is presented.
